scope: Post-transfer-window roster correction after a 96-club, 288-slot current-squad audit.

changes.note: Burkardt remains first after multiple Frankfurt conversions. Batshuayi has left, so Can Uzun and Mario Götze are the current-squad deputies pending a new same-pitch penalty.
Mika Baur has left. Klaas is promoted from the evidenced deputy position; Michel and set-piece specialist Obermair are provisional backups until Paderborn receive a current-season penalty.
Buendía remains first after taking Villa's May 2026 penalty. Watkins has left; Abraham and Barkley are the current experienced deputies, without a new direct ordering event.
Palmer remains the clear first choice. Enzo Fernández has left; Estêvão is promoted from the previous hierarchy and João Pedro is the provisional third option.
Mateta and Sarr retain their evidenced first-two order. Devenny has left; Wharton is the provisional current-squad third option on set-piece responsibility.
Ndiaye and Beto left on deadline day. Garner previously converted with Barry available and is the strongest observed current-squad call; Barry and Dewsbury-Hall are provisional deputies.

Robinson retains first place after Fulham's latest direct conversion and Muniz remains the existing deputy. Lukić has left; the current set-piece list adds Gonzalo García as the provisional third option.
Calvert-Lewin and Nmecha retain the observed first-two order. Piroe has left; experienced specialist Harry Wilson is the current-squad third choice.
Haaland remains the established first choice and Doku the existing deputy. Marmoush has left; the current set-piece list adds Semenyo as the current-squad third option.
Giroud remains first. Fernandez-Pardo and Broholm have left; Bentaleb's specialist history and Igamane's attacking role make them the current provisional deputies.
Panichelli remains the established primary. Enciso and Moreira have left; Nanasi and Reyna are provisional current-squad deputies until a direct event settles the order.

Nkunku has left for Leipzig. The 1 September hierarchy keeps Ramos ahead of Pulisic; current Italian specialist lists add Modrić as the third current-squad option while the first same-pitch penalty remains decisive.
Pessina remains the established primary and Cutrone the existing deputy. Petagna has left; Colpani is the provisional current-squad third choice.

Dejan Ljubičić is no longer in Union Berlin's current squad. Kemlein remains first, Köhn is promoted from the existing hierarchy and experienced set-piece specialist Skov is the provisional third option.
Oyarzabal remains the clear primary and Soler the current deputy after Brais Méndez's departure. Guedes fills the provisional third slot pending a direct 2026/27 event.
Ajorque and Lala retain the post-Del Castillo order. Doumbia fills the current-squad third slot until Brest receive a direct post-transfer penalty.
Samatta and Rassoul Ndiaye retain the post-Zouaoui order. Maja is the current attacking fallback pending a direct 2026/27 penalty.
Diop remains the retained successful primary and Clauss the deputy after Moffi's departure. Wahi is the current attacking third option.

Locatelli remains first after direct coach confirmation with Yıldız available. Current Italian specialist boards include Kolo Muani in the top three; the ordering remains disputed until another same-pitch penalty.
Albert Gudmundsson is a Fiorentina player and was wrongly inserted into Lazio's hierarchy. Current Italian specialist sources list Zaccagni, Cataldi and Taylor in this order.
